原: …at Real Madrid, mr. / Sanchez has a very high public profile.
疑为: …at Real Madrid, Mr. Sanchez has a very high public profile.
理由: Mr. 被当成句末句号切开，且 mr 小写；按整句译。

原: …how imperative it would be to respect mr. / Sanchez’s private life.
…run common everyday chores for mr. / Sanchez.
疑为: …run common everyday chores for Mr. Sanchez.

原: This is my first job after graduating from university, so. / Frankly, I don’t have much prior working experience.
疑为: …from university, so, frankly, I don’t have much prior working experience.
理由: so 后被句号切断；按整句意思译。

原: Although tech companies will often speak of environmental sustainability. / Many lobby against repair legislation, …
疑为: Although tech companies will often speak of environmental sustainability, many lobby against …
理由: 让步从句被句号与主句切开；按整句译。

原: cost employers up to 85 billion a year
疑为: cost employers up to $85 billion a year
理由: 损失金额漏了货币单位，显然指美元；译作“850亿美元”。

原: recover from stress or work situations
理由: stress or 与 stressful 发音相近，“从压力或工作情境中恢复”说不通；译作“从压力大的工作情境中恢复”。

原: When my research team and I dated these teeth. / We found they were more than 70,000 years old, …
疑为: When my research team and I dated these teeth, we found …
理由: 时间状语从句被句号与主句切开；按整句译。

原: For instance. / Some monkeys in Africa …
疑为: For instance, some monkeys in Africa …
理由: For instance 后被句号切断；按整句译。
